chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-22

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-22 Propose a structure for an aromatic hydrocarbon, C11H16, that has the following 13C NMR spectral data: Broadband decoupled: 29.5, 31.8, 50.2, 125.5, 127.5, 130.3, 139.8 δ DEPT-90: 125.5, 127.5, 130.3 δ DEPT-135: positive peaks at 29.5, 125.5, 127.5, 130.3 δ; negative peak at 50.2 δ
